data_fields.name: priority_enum_order
data_fields.donor_constant: Default 0, WeaponLowerBody 1, SneakIdleLowerBody 2, SwimIdle 3, Jump 4, Movement 5, Hit 6, Weapon 7, Block 8, Knockdown 9, Torch 10, Storm 11, Death 12, Scripted 13

data_fields.name: body_groups
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 (lower body, torso, left arm, right arm)

best_idea: Pick each body group's clip separately by a per-group priority, so a block lifts only the arm while the legs keep walking, and ease from the pose on screen when the switch happens.
decision_why: The per-group winner and the snapshot-then-ease blend are the shape the hero needs (block lifts the arm while the legs keep walking, no pop on switch); Frankendom keys priorities by named hero state in data instead of OpenMW's integer enum, and the engine keeps the fight state while the layers only draw it.
acceptance: Headless test: walk (all groups, priority 5) plus block (left arm 8, lower body 1, torso and right arm 6), no weapon clip: lower reports walk, left arm, torso and right arm report block; walk-to-block eases over the rig rule duration with no snap while the legs keep stepping.
